scripts.cf:upload: npm run cf:build && wrangler versions upload
scripts.cf:business:check: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const {spawnSync}=require('node:child_process');const id='a9968e365a6bee7bb86a380662067095';const fail=m=>{console.error(m);process.exit(1)};if(process.argv.length>1)fail('Business account check does not accept overrides');const c=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('wrangler.business.jsonc','utf8'));if(c.account_id!==id||c.name!=='benkai-systems-business'||c.vars?.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL!=='https://benkaisystems.co.ke')fail('Business configuration mismatch');for(const k of ['CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID','CF_ACCOUNT_ID'])if(process.env[k]&&process.env[k]!==id)fail('Account mismatch: '+k);if(process.env.CLOUDFLARE_ENV)fail('Business deployment does not accept CLOUDFLARE_ENV');const r=spawnSync(process.execPath,[require('node:path').resolve(require.resolve('wrangler/package.json'),'..',require('wrangler/package.json').bin.wrangler),'whoami','--json','--config','wrangler.business.jsonc'],{encoding:'utf8',env:{...process.env,CI:'true',CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID:id}});if(r.error||r.status!==0)fail('Unable to verify Cloudflare authentication');let u;try{u=JSON.parse(r.stdout)}catch{fail('Invalid Cloudflare identity response')}if(u.loggedIn!==true||!Array.isArray(u.accounts)||!u.accounts.some(a=>a.id===id))fail('Authenticated identity cannot access the business account');console.log('Verified business account '+id+' and Worker '+c.name)"
scripts.cf:business:deploy: node -e "const {spawnSync}=require('node:child_process');if(process.argv.length>1){console.error('Business deployment does not accept target overrides');process.exit(1)}const env={...process.env,CI:'true'};const run=args=>{const r=spawnSync(process.execPath,args,{stdio:'inherit',env});if(r.error||r.status!==0)process.exit(r.status||1)};run([process.env.npm_execpath,'run','cf:business:check']);run([process.env.npm_execpath,'run','cf:business:build']);run([process.env.npm_execpath,'run','cf:business:check']);env.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID='a9968e365a6bee7bb86a380662067095';run([require('node:path').resolve(require.resolve('wrangler/package.json'),'..',require('wrangler/package.json').bin.wrangler),'deploy','--config','wrangler.business.jsonc'])"
